answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 3829 Country: India Title: My name is Muntazir Nabi. Is there any problem with my name in the eyes of shariah? Question: My name is Muntazir Nabi. Is there any problem with my name in the eyes of shariah? Answer ID: 3829 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 65/65=M) It is not right to keep name as 'Muntzir Nabi' since the word ' منتظر ' whether pronounced as muntazir or muntazar both do not have good meaning. Therefore, change it to only Muntazir or Muhammad Muntazir or Muntazir Alam or something else. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
